## **FEATURE REQUEST GUIDELINES**
PanchoRing is a mature project ecosystem. Your request will be reviewed ONLY if: 
- It can be achieved by making changes inside the config files, datapacks, or resourcepacks.
- It is related to content that exists inside PanchoRing (I'm not adding Create support, ever.)

**If your request doesn't stick to those two rules, it is very unlikely to be considered.**

|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

_Please describe your request, why it could work, and any details with a concise text._
_That way, neither of us wastes the other's time with unnecessary misunderstandings._
